49/G.goal: Explain how immersive VR optimization separates experience and resource concerns and why cybersickness, presence, locomotion, and walking-speed matching guide experience optimization in system-controlled virtual reality tours.
49/G.achieves: It gives the learner a foundation for making cybersickness- and presence-aware experience optimization decisions in XR systems, supporting the course aim of understanding and implementing an XR system with confidence.

49/O1.goal: Characterize immersive VR experience optimization by distinguishing it from resource optimization and by identifying cybersickness, its causes, and the requirement to preserve presence.
49/O1.achieves: It lets the learner recognize why experience optimization is distinct from resource optimization and why cybersickness mitigation must not degrade presence.

49/O2.goal: Describe how VR locomotion techniques, navigation duration or distance, and optic-flow walking-speed matching motivate a walking-speed model for system-controlled virtual reality tours.
49/O2.achieves: It gives the learner a basis for evaluating locomotion and walking-speed choices that reduce cybersickness in system-controlled tours while maintaining presence.
